messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: usw-infer-pool node flapping (NotReady -> Ready -> NotReady) — 4 nodes affected, error rate on inference endpoints increased. Pager: eng-oncall
Emma K: seeing spikes in 5xx on /v1/generate for customers. 10% error rate over last 3m.
Samir: thanks, I'm on it. pulling up node list now.
Samir: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw -o wide` shows 4 nodes NotReady intermittently, last Ready seen ~30s ago on one.
Nisha P: any kernel oops or kubelet restarts in journal?
Samir: grabbing logs from node-uw2-gpu-07 `ssh node-uw2-gpu-07 sudo journalctl -u kubelet -n 200`
Samir: logs show repeated kubelet restart entries and containerd complaining about failed to start container: "driver init: CUDA: out of memory" then containerd restart loop.
Lucy: that matches a customer trace — we saw CUDA allocation failures in the runtime logs, followed by pod eviction.
Rajesh: could be driver + kernel combo. Did we push any node kernel/driver updates in the last window?
infra-bot: deploy-bot noticed a rolling host-image update rolled through region us-west-2 ~15m ago (image: gpu-runtime-36.2 -> 36.3). No automatic rollback performed.
Emma K: customer impact: three customers on high-throughput plans saw elevated latency and errors; internal dashboard shows 28% P50 increase and 12% request failures to the affected model shard.
Samir: immediate mitigation proposal: cordon the flapping nodes, drain them, and scale up fallback pool in eu-west to absorb traffic. also enable model-variant fallback to smaller-quantized variant.
Nisha P: agree. do we have spare capacity in eu-west?
Lucy: yes, we have warm capacity in eu-west-dedicated that can take ~1200 rps for the shard. I'll open a manual routing override.
Rajesh: I'll start cordon/drain. Samir, can you prep the fallback routing?
Samir: running: `kubectl cordon node-uw2-gpu-07 && kubectl drain node-uw2-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
Samir: drain started. Pod eviction shows some long-lived KV cache warm-ups; we'll accept some cold-start latency.
Emma K: notified Customer Success with a brief: "We're investigating GPU driver-induced node restarts in us-west, traffic may be routed to eu-west; some requests may see increased latency or model variant fallback."
PagerDuty: eskalation: if >30m to full recovery, page infra-rotation.
Samir: fallback routing applied: model-route for shard-42 now has secondary region eu-west with lower weight 30% -> ramping to 100% if error threshold persists.
Lucy: warm instances in eu-west are spinning up containers, logs show successful model load for smaller-quant variant.
Samir: observing client error rate drop to 3% and P50 trending down.
Nisha P: collecting node logs for postmortem: `journalctl -u kubelet -o short-iso --since -1h > /tmp/node-uw2-gpu-07-kubelet.log` and `dmesg | tail -n 200` saved. seeing repeated kernel OOM messages tied to nvidia.
Rajesh: checking driver versions: node shows nvidia-driver 540.123 vs host-image expected 535.x — mismatch during host-image rollout.
Emma K: that explains CUDA entrypoint OOMs when runtime tried to initialize newer driver ABI with older runtime libs.
Samir: action items: 1) pause host-image rollout in us-west 2) roll back nodes to previous image or drain and reprovision with correct driver 3) temporary routing policy to keep traffic in eu-west until we've validated.
Lucy: I've flagged the customers impacted and posted a note in the status page draft.
Rajesh: I'm starting a controlled repro on a spare node: launching the host-image 36.3 to observe driver handshake. will attach kernel logs.
Samir: monitoring, so far steady. can we keep this thread for runbook notes?
Emma K: yes. long-term: add a preflight check to verify driver-runtime ABI compatibility before host-image rollout. tag infra-release.
Nisha P: allocating postmortem owner: Rajesh. timeframe: initial writeup within 48h.
infra-bot: Rollout paused for us-west-2 (user: Rajesh).
Samir: marking incident as mitigated for customer-facing traffic; internal mitigation still ongoing. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> customer impact reduced; full remediation in progress.
Emma K: thanks team. follow-up: add a canary gate to block driver-host-image combos without runtime-lib match.
Rajesh: saving logs to /mnt/incident-logs/1718504321/ and attaching to the postmortem.
Lucy: leaving the routing override for 30m to confirm stability. if stable, we'll gradually remove and bring capacity back to us-west.
Samir: last check: error rate steady at 0.8%, latency back to baseline. closing active pager.
PagerDuty: Pager cleared.
incident-bot: Thread closed by Emma K at 2024-07-08T17:09:00Z
